-- For more scripts, join discord. (https://discord.gg/JH8Kqtqq3m)

-- > Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game.GetService(game, 'ReplicatedStorage')
local UserInputService = game.GetService(game, 'UserInputService')
local Players = game.GetService(game, 'Players')

-- > Variables
local MiscHandler, LocalPlayer, Camera = require(ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('MiscHandler', true)), Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

-- > Functions
function GetClosestTarget()
	local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
	for Index, Value in next, Players.GetPlayers(Players) do
		if LocalPlayer == Value or (Value.Team and Value.Team.Name == 'Lobby') or (LocalPlayer.Team and LocalPlayer.Team.Name ~= 'FFA' and (LocalPlayer.Team == Value.Team or ((MiscHandler.Relationships[LocalPlayer.Team.Name] and MiscHandler.Relationships[LocalPlayer.Team.Name][Value.Team and Value.Team.Name]) or 'Enemy') == 'Friendly')) then continue end
		--
		local Character = Value.Character
		if not Character then continue end
		--
		local Head = game.FindFirstChild(Character, 'Head')
		if not Head then continue end
		--
		local Humanoid = game.FindFirstChildOfClass(Character, 'Humanoid')
		if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
		--
		local Obscuring = Camera.GetPartsObscuringTarget(Camera, {Camera.CFrame.Position, Head.Position}, {Character, LocalPlayer.Character})
		for Meow = #Obscuring, 1, -1 do
			local Part = Obscuring[Meow]
			if Part.Transparency >= 1 or not Part.CanCollide then
				table.remove(Obscuring, Meow)
			end
		end
		--
		if #Obscuring > 0 then continue end
		--
		local Vector, OnScreen = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, Head.Position)
		if not OnScreen then continue end
		--
		local Distance = (Vector2.new(Vector.X, Vector.Y) - UserInputService.GetMouseLocation(UserInputService)).Magnitude
		if Distance < Closest then Closest, Target = Distance, Head end
	end
	--
	return Target
end

-- > Connections
local Identity, Detected, Kill = getthreadidentity(), nil, nil

setthreadidentity(2)
for Index, Value in next, getgc(true) do
  if typeof(Value) == 'function' then
    if debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'recoil' then
      hookfunction(Value, function(...) end)
    end
  elseif typeof(Value) == 'table' then
    if typeof(rawget(Value, 'Detected')) == 'function' and not Detected then
      Detected = rawget(Value, 'Detected') hookfunction(Detected, function(...) return true end)
    elseif rawget(Value, 'Variables') and rawget(Value, 'Process') and typeof(rawget(Value, 'Kill')) == 'function' and not Kill then
      Kill = rawget(Value, 'Kill') hookfunction(Kill, function(...) end)
    end
  end
end

local Original; Original = hookfunction(getrenv().debug.info, newcclosure(function(...)
	local Args = {...}
	if Detected and Args[1] == Detected then
		return coroutine.yield(coroutine.running())
	end
	--
	return Original(table.unpack(Args))
end))

setthreadidentity(Identity)
local Original; Original = hookmetamethod(game, '__namecall', newcclosure(function(self, ...)
	local Args, Method, Script = {...}, getnamecallmethod(), getcallingscript()
	if self == workspace and Method == 'Raycast' and tostring(Script) == 'WeaponSystem_Overhaul' then
		local Target = GetClosestTarget()
		if not Target then return Original(self, table.unpack(Args)) end
		Args[2] = (Target.Position - Args[1]).Unit * 1000
	end
	--
	return Original(self, table.unpack(Args))
end))

A performant, minimalist, and fully customizable Roblox script GUI by ToRo.

⚡ General Features & Functions
🚀 Vehicle & Boat Boost
Speed Control: Adjustable velocity slider from 10 to 500 studs/s.

Dual Activation: Use via hold keybind or toggle mode.

Smart Detection: Automatically locates vehicle seats and root parts to apply directional velocity.

Live Status Display: Shows real-time boost status (Active vs. Standby).

🖱️ Autoclicker
CPS Adjustment: Customizable click speed from 1 to 50 CPS.

Hotkey Toggle: Dedicated keybind to enable/disable instantly.

Universal Compatibility: Uses mouse1click with fallback to VirtualInputManager.

🏃 Player & Performance Mods
WalkSpeed & JumpPower Modifiers: Custom movement speed and jump height controls.

Anti-AFK: Built-in protection against getting kicked for inactivity.

Safe AFK Optimizer: Lowers rendering quality and freezes physics/particles to save performance while AFK.

🎨 Theme & Customization
Redesigned Interface: Clean, modern tabbed layout with a draggable header bar.

Custom Accent Colors: Real-time RGB sliders for custom highlight colors.

Rainbow Mode: Dynamic HSV cycling for continuous rainbow effects.

Background Customization: Independent RGB color, transparency, and darkness sliders.

💾 Config System (JSON Persistence)

FPS & Ping Overlay: Real-time performance monitor displayed directly on-screen.

UI Scale Slider: Adjustable interface scaling from 50% to 150%.

Hide UI Hotkey: Toggle interface visibility anytime using RightControl.

Clean Unload: Safely terminates all loops, disconnects events, and destroys the GUI.

🔄 What's New in v1.2
UI Enhancement: Further beautified and polished interface elements for an even cleaner look.
Tab Reorganization: Re-sorted tabs and moved the Autoclicker directly into the Main tab for better accessibility.
Player Modifications: Added dedicated toggles and sliders for WalkSpeed and JumpPower.
